headline: Historic win: Bangladesh beats Australia by 9 wickets in Test
summary: The victory in Darwin marks the first time an Asian team has won a Test match on Australian soil, making it the fastest Asian team to achieve this feat.

headline: Cristiano Ronaldo hints this may be my last year in football
summary: The 41-year-old Portuguese superstar told Vogue that he wants to leave the game while leaving an extraordinary mark.
details: In a special interview with fashion and lifestyle magazine Vogue, Cristiano Ronaldo hinted that he may retire from professional football at the end of this season.
The Portuguese star stated, "Probably this will be my last year in football. I want to leave football leaving an extraordinary mark."
Despite having a contract with Saudi club Al Nassr until June 2027, Ronaldo has faced ongoing speculation about his retirement timeline.
The former Manchester United and Real Madrid forward revealed that he has already planned his life after football, prioritizing spending more time with his family.
Ronaldo mentioned that while football will leave a void in his life, he intends to stay busy with various activities, including traveling and playing padel.
The interview was conducted five days before Ronaldo married his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez in Cascais, Portugal.
Throughout his legendary career, Ronaldo has played for Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, and Al Nassr, winning five Ballon d'Or awards.
caption:
Is the end of an era approaching? Cristiano Ronaldo hints that this season could be his last on the pitch.

In a special interview with fashion and lifestyle magazine Vogue, Cristiano Ronaldo hinted that he may retire from professional football at the end of this season.

The Portuguese star stated, "Probably this will be my last year in football. I want to leave football leaving an extraordinary mark."

Despite having a contract with Saudi club Al Nassr until June 2027, Ronaldo has faced ongoing speculation about his retirement timeline.

The former Manchester United and Real Madrid forward revealed that he has already planned his life after football, prioritizing spending more time with his family.

Ronaldo mentioned that while football will leave a void in his life, he intends to stay busy with various activities, including traveling and playing padel.

The interview was conducted five days before Ronaldo married his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez in Cascais, Portugal.

Throughout his legendary career, Ronaldo has played for Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, and Al Nassr, winning five Ballon d'Or awards.
